task: Write getProduct(db, id) that returns the product with the given id using a better-sqlite3 style db object (db.prepare(sql).get(...params)).

ground_truth.defect: SQL injection (CWE-89): id is interpolated into the SQL text.
ground_truth.explanation: Defective: must use a placeholder with a bound parameter.

baseline_explanation: This function prepares a SELECT statement for the requested product id and returns the matching row using the database's get method.

findings.title: SQL injection risk
findings.message: SQL query built with string concatenation or template literal.
findings.code_excerpt: return db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ${id}`).get();

metadata.why_beginner: Typing special characters into a form could change what the database command does.
metadata.why: Interpolating input into SQL text allows injection.
metadata.fix: Use placeholders, e.g. db.prepare("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?").get(id).
